in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shisheer in Sanskrit is derived from the Sanskrit word शिशीर (Shishir), which means 'frosty, icy, cool'. This name is often used to describe the winter season, as it is characterized by its frosty and cool weather.

in_tamil.name: சிசையர்
